Video Display Sync
Problems

This game board provides separate positive horizontal and vertical sync on a separate connector, for monitors that will not work with the composite negative sync signal provided at the JAMMA edge connector. This connector (labeled “Sync”) is located near the edge connector. Pin 1 is horizontal sync, Pin 2 is vertical sync, and Pin 3 is ground.
Troubleshooting
